Top candidates: Northern Leaf Blight (large elongated tan lesions), Southern Corn Leaf Blight (tan lesions between veins), Goss's Wilt (water-soaked streaks).

Let me view one reference image from Northern Leaf Blight.

The Northern Leaf Blight reference shows the characteristic large, elongated cigar-shaped tan lesions running parallel to the veins — which matches the test image well. The test image shows a more advanced/coalesced stage of the same disease, where multiple NLB lesions have merged across the leaf, creating the extensive tan-brown necrotic pattern with remnant green patches.
